messages:
maya: Opening PR #4330  migration notes + compact SDK snippets (Python + TS). Planning to land in the 16:00 PT docs window. reviewers?
ben: I can do a pass. checklist: glossary terms (workspace not tenant), no inline secrets, prefer present-tense voice.
riley: I'll check code samples. please use `Client.from_env()` and generator streaming.
maya: swapped inline keys to `Client.from_env()`, updated phrasing in most steps. added a tiny before/after table for route flags.
tone-bot: style check: two instances of the word 'simple' flagged; replace with 'straightforward' or more specific guidance. also recommend swapping a couple imperatives for softer phrasing.
ben: tone pass: changed "Do X" -> "You can X" in the checklist and replaced both 'simple' occurrences. left one punctuation nit in a list item.
riley: code pass: streaming example should be generator-style. change this:
```python
with client.stream_responses(prompt) as s:
    for part in s:
        print(part.text)
```
to:
```python
for part in client.stream_responses(prompt):
    print(part.text)
```
(no context-manager implied).
maya: updated snippets to generator style and added an inline note about backpressure and buffering. fixed the punctuation nit and rebased.
ci-bot: docs preview build: failed -> LinkCheckError: anchor 'routing-fallbacks' not found in migration.md.
maya: fixing header anchor typo and pushing a patch now.
preview-bot: preview ready: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4330  please review formatting and tone.
ben: looks good to me; approval from docs.
riley: approved from code POV; left tiny optional suggestion about logging chunk sizes.
maya: thanks all  merging at 16:08 PT (10 minute buffer after window).
ci-bot: final build: success, 0 warnings.
preview-bot: deploy preview updated: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4330 
maya: merged PR #4330  appreciate the quick tone/code passes — reads well for developer audience.
